name: Barba JS
description: Integrates the Barba.js library for creating badass, fluid and smooth transitions between pages.
project_description: Barba JS integrates the Barba.js JavaScript library into Drupal to deliver smooth, SPA-like transitions between pages. The base module ships the Barba UMD builds (core, plus the CSS, Prefetch and Router plugins) under dist/ and auto-attaches core on every front-end page via hook_page_attachments(): it prefers a local build (bundled dist/ or a /libraries/barba install) and falls back to the pinned jsDelivr CDN when no local file is found. It has no jQuery dependency and adds no permissions or configuration of its own — you write your transitions in theme or module JavaScript with barba.init(). The optional Barba JS UI submodule adds an admin form to control loading (on/off, local vs CDN, minified vs development, which plugins), and to restrict attachment by theme and by path pattern.
